series.title: Kaanch Ka Mahal
series.synopsis: Meera, newly married into a Lucknow haveli, finds a stranger standing beside her husband in every wedding photograph. The family insists no such man exists. He is at the door.

series.title: CEO Sahab
series.synopsis: To save her father's shuttered printing press, a proofreader signs a one-year marriage contract with the man she believes is her boss's driver.

series.title: Dilli 6 Ka Raaz
series.synopsis: A Chandni Chowk locksmith opens a shutter that has been sealed for thirty years and finds the tools of his own father's unsolved crime.

series.title: Saat Pheron Ka Sauda
series.synopsis: A wedding planner marries her most difficult client for ninety days so his grandmother can die happy. The grandmother recovers.

series.title: Raja Ki Beti
series.synopsis: A Jaipur museum guide begins remembering a fort's 1743 siege from inside it, as the descendant of the man who lost it quietly buys the fort back.

series.title: Neend Se Pehle
series.synopsis: A night-shift radio host in Bhopal takes calls from a listener who describes tomorrow's accidents. Tonight, he describes hers.

series.title: Kabir Ka Kanoon
series.synopsis: A court stenographer who typed the lie that jailed his brother spends four years learning the law well enough to unmake it.

series.title: Nizam Ka Sauda
series.synopsis: An Old City antiques dealer sells a forged farman to the wrong buyer and has nine days to produce the real one.

series.title: Kadhal Kanakku
series.synopsis: A Coimbatore auditor is sent to close her ex-fiance's failing mill and finds her own forged signature in its books.

series.title: Vetri Vaasal
series.synopsis: A Madurai jallikattu family's daughter takes her banned brother's place in a kabaddi league that has never let a woman on the mat.

series.title: Sunday Sambar
series.synopsis: Four siblings inherit their mother's Mylapore mess and her rule: the recipe passes to whoever can cook Sunday lunch without the others walking out.

series.title: Prema Pariksha
series.synopsis: A Vizag coaching-centre teacher tutors a repeat-year student who is thirty-one, brilliant, and quietly buying the college that employs her.

series.title: Rajahmundry Rani
series.synopsis: A widow keeps her late husband's Godavari boat business alive by pretending, for one season, that he is alive too.

series.title: Nalugu Ghantalu
series.synopsis: A Hyderabad ambulance driver relives the same four hours until he stops trying to save the patient and starts trying to find who put her there.
